entities.summary: William Maher is an American television host, comedian, actor and political commentator. Known for his political satire, he is the host of the HBO political talk show Real Time with Bill Maher (2003–present) and podcast Club Random (2022–present). He previously hosted late-night show called Politically Incorrect (1993–2002) on ABC and Comedy Central.
